subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Are the 14 proposed upstream GitHub Action revisions approved to execute in OpenClaw's token-minting, secret-bearing, release, security-scanning, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: Repository tests can validate the resulting workflows but cannot establish maintainer trust in newly pinned third-party executable revisions that receive credentials or elevated repository permissions.

options.title: Approve refreshed revisions
options.body: Rebase or regenerate the update, verify each official release and full SHA, then merge after exact-head workflow checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Land lower-risk setup actions separately and hold token, release, CodeQL, Docker-login, and Codex-action updates for individual review.

options.title: Pause the grouped bump
options.body: Leave the current pins unchanged until an owner can audit the upstream revisions or Dependabot can regenerate a clean current-base branch.

recommendation.title: Approve refreshed revisions
recommendation.body: Rebase or regenerate the update, verify each official release and full SHA, then merge after exact-head workflow checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is explicitly present in the PR timeline and is the strongest available routing signal for the cross-cutting workflow trust decision.
